note: What a server sends to say a champion died. The header names the unit this is about.

fields.name: killer
fields.note: The unit credited with the death. A client sent its own champion here, as the unit that died, still plays the death.

fields.name: damageType
fields.note: What sort of damage the death came from. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: damageSource
fields.note: Where that damage came from. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: stayDown
fields.note: How long the champion stays down, in seconds. A client counts its respawn timer down from it.

bits.name: unknown1
bits.note: Purpose undetermined. Clear in everything observed.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of death it is. Zero in everything observed.
